question: What maximum inbound QQ gateway message size should OpenClaw enforce without rejecting legitimate events?
rationale: The threshold trades resource-exhaustion protection against valid message delivery, and neither the external protocol nor current repository tests define the correct ceiling.

options.title: Require authoritative ceiling
options.body: Keep the PR open until official QQ documentation or QQBot-owner evidence supports the threshold and recovery behavior is proven.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB operationally
options.body: Accept 1 MiB as an explicitly owner-chosen operational bound despite the absence of a published QQ maximum.

options.title: Use a more conservative bound
options.body: Choose a larger owner-approved ceiling that still substantially reduces the upstream 100 MiB default while lowering compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require authoritative ceiling
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until official QQ documentation or QQBot-owner evidence supports the threshold and recovery behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the current QQBot gateway transport architecture and is best positioned to confirm its legitimate payload envelope.
